newsitem.title: USA: MGE spring wheat ends steady to up but off highs.
newsitem.headline: MGE spring wheat ends steady to up but off highs.

text.p: MGE spring wheat futures closed steady to higher on Wednesday but light hedge selling late in the session erased earlier gains, floor traders said.
"There was a little bit of hedge pressure that showed up late and that capped any gains," a trader said.
Mill buying by ADM reportedly limited gains, traders said.
The market opened higher on commercial buying tied to export business but gains were pared as CBOT futures slipped.
Slovenia overnight bought U.S. spring wheat and commercials were said to be pricing business to South Korea and to the Commodity Credit Corp's grain donation program.
Barley futures were lower with an estimated four contracts traded in the December and the March, a trader said.
"Corn gave up a little ground today and barley followed," a trader said.
Wheat closed unchanged to 2-1/2 cents per bushel higher with December steady at $4.22-3/4. Barley ended one to two cents per cwt lower with December down one at $6.99.
